instruction:
Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. For this workflow, use the SOLIDWORKS 2025 and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop for the two stages of this workflow. Start from a blank SolidWorks part and use N-mm-MPa units.

Chain evidence requirement: preserve EW_SW_ABQ_07 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS in the STEP text, and preserve EW_SW_ABQ_07 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step in a native Abaqus name or job description.

1. In SolidWorks, create one connected 6 mm thick capsule-ended link. In XY, union the rectangle 20<=X<=140 mm, 0<=Y<=40 mm with R20 mm end circles centered at (20,20) and (140,20) mm, giving an overall 160 by 40 mm outline. Cut D14 eye holes at those same centers. Cut a centered 60 by 12 mm through obround slot: its R6 ends are centered at (56,20) and (104,20) mm and its straight sides run from X=56 to 104 mm at Y=14 and 26 mm. Export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. Import the STEP into Model-SlottedLinkTension. Define Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, assign a homogeneous solid section, and use first-order C3D4/C3D8R elements with no quadratic elements and no more than 1000 nodes. Create LEFT_EYE and RIGHT_EYE from the respective cylindrical hole faces, SLOT_EDGE from all four slot-wall faces, and RIGHT_EYE_SURFACE from the right eye face. Create Static, General step Step-Tension. Apply BC-LeftEye with U1=U2=U3=0. Create a reference point at (140,20,3) mm, connect it to RIGHT_EYE_SURFACE with distributing coupling Coupling-RightEye, and apply Load-RightTension as CF1=+1200 N. Submit Job-SlottedLinkTension and wait for completion.
3. Required Desktop deliverables: stage1_geometry.step, Job-SlottedLinkTension.cae, and Job-SlottedLinkTension.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.
